Also, in the last month, there have been a ton of flies buzzing around this area, so much so that the building manager called an exterminator. At some point, she must have cried to her boss about it, because her boss found me today and asked if I confronted her intern. But now that it's the weekend and I'm sufficiently caffeinated, I'm wondering AITA for calling her out?
